Gen. Robert E. Cushman Jr.

Project 54 · Joint Chiefs of Staff, Commandant of the Marine Corps, from templates-jcs/cushman.json · index · repo randomcase/gen-robert-e-cushman-jr

Commandant of the Marine Corps · 1972–1975 · at the fall, 1975-04-30

Commandant on the fall date, two months from retirement. The last two Americans killed in Vietnam, McMahon and Judge, were his Marines, at Tan Son Nhut on 29 April.

The office

The Joint Staff, the Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia. The Chairman’s office is on the E-ring, second floor, river side; the Chiefs meet in the “Tank”, Room 2E924, and from 1972 in the Gold Room next to it.
